top_signals.title: DSC CFO Zou on Strategy, Profitability
top_signals.summary: Qin Zou, Chief Financial Officer of DSC Holdings, said the company is nearing break-even, pointing to data insights and digital infrastructure as key competitive advantages in supporting used-car dealers. She spoke exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
